aboutPage.heroDesc: A language- and location-independent health and medical-tourism marketplace that brings patients together with expert doctors and verified clinics/hospitals on one digital platform.
aboutPage.whatDesc: Medagama is a multilingual platform that brings doctor and clinic search, online booking, telehealth and medical-tourism workflows together in one place. Users search by specialty and city, review profiles and get in touch directly. Clinics and doctors manage their profiles to reach a wider patient audience.
aboutPage.missionDesc: To remove the information gap and uncertainty in accessing healthcare. By bringing expert doctors and clinics onto one platform, we make comparison, patient reviews and second opinions easy.
aboutPage.visionDesc: To make reaching the right healthcare transparent, understandable and accessible worldwide; to be the trusted digital bridge in medical tourism.
aboutPage.forPatientsDesc: Find expert doctors and clinics with specialty and city filters, book appointments, schedule telehealth visits and read verified patient reviews.
aboutPage.forClinicsDesc: Create your profile, manage your appointments, grow your patient reach and run your operation from one panel with integrated CRM tools.
aboutPage.value1Desc: All data is processed encrypted, in line with KVKK, GDPR and HIPAA principles.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Clinic and doctor profiles are verified by the platform for identity and credentials.
aboutPage.value3Desc: A 9-language interface supports the medical-tourism journey without language or location barriers.
aboutPage.scopeDesc: Medagama serves not only local patients but also medical-tourism visitors from abroad. Thanks to its multilingual structure, users from different countries can review, compare and contact expert doctors and clinics in Türkiye.
aboutPage.faq1A: No. Medagama is a healthcare marketplace; it does not provide diagnosis or treatment advice. It connects you with expert doctors and clinics. All medical decisions should be made together with your physician.

kvkk.title: KVKK Disclosure Text
kvkk.subtitle: Law No. 6698 on Protection of Personal Data
kvkk.summary_text: At Medagama, we take all necessary technical and administrative measures to protect your personal data in accordance with Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and related legislation. This disclosure text transparently explains how your data is processed.
kvkk.s1_content: Medagama Health Technologies Inc. ("Medagama") processes your personal data as the data controller within the scope of the Law No. 6698 on Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK"). Medagama attaches great importance to the security of your personal data and takes all technical and administrative measures.
kvkk.s2_content: Your personal data is processed for the purposes of providing health services, appointment management, telehealth services, patient-doctor communication, billing and payment transactions, fulfilling legal obligations, improving service quality, and statistical analysis.
kvkk.s3_title: 3. Legal Reasons for Processing Personal Data
kvkk.s3_content: Your personal data is processed based on the legal reasons specified in Articles 5 and 6 of KVKK: your explicit consent, performance of a contract, legal obligation, establishment/exercise/protection of a right, and legitimate interest. Your special category personal data (health data) is processed only with your explicit consent or for the purpose of protecting public health.
kvkk.s4_content: Your personal data may be shared with service providers, business partners, legal authorities, and authorized public institutions and organizations in accordance with the conditions specified in Articles 8 and 9 of KVKK. Data transfer abroad is carried out to countries with adequate protection or with your explicit consent.
kvkk.s5_content: Your personal data is retained for the duration required by the processing purposes and within the scope of legal retention obligations. Health data is retained for at least 10 years due to legal obligation, financial records for 5 years, and account data for 3 years from account closure.
kvkk.s6_content: Pursuant to Article 11 of KVKK, you have the right to: learn whether your personal data is processed, request information if processed, learn the purpose of processing and whether they are used in accordance with the purpose, know the third parties to whom personal data is transferred, request correction if processed incompletely or incorrectly, request deletion or destruction, request notification of corrections/deletions to third parties, object to any result that arises against you through analysis of processed data exclusively by automatic systems, and claim compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing.
kvkk.s7_content: To exercise the rights mentioned above, you can send an email to kvkk@medgama.com or visit the "Data Rights" page on our platform. Your applications will be responded to free of charge within 30 days at the latest.
